categories.main_business_segments: Cardinal Health operates through two main business segments: the Pharmaceutical segment and the Medical segment. The Pharmaceutical segment focuses on the distribution of branded and generic pharmaceuticals, specialty pharmaceuticals, and over-the-counter healthcare products, primarily in the United States. The Medical segment manufactures, sources, and distributes Cardinal Health branded and national brand medical, surgical, and laboratory products, and provides supply chain services and solutions to healthcare providers globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced distribution logistics, inventory management systems, and automated technology platforms (such as Wavemark for inventory management and OptiFreight Logistics for shipping optimization) to enhance supply chain efficiency. In manufacturing, Cardinal Health utilizes both in-house production and sourcing from third-party suppliers for medical products, and operates nuclear pharmacies and radiopharmaceutical manufacturing facilities for specialized healthcare solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cardinal Health serves hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies (including chain and independent drug stores), ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, physician offices, and patients in the home. Major customers include large pharmacy chains (notably CVS Health and OptumRx), group purchasing organizations (GPOs) like Vizient and Premier, and a wide range of healthcare providers across the continuum of care.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary operations are in the United States, which accounts for the vast majority of revenue, but it also has significant activities in Canada, Europe, Asia, and other international markets. The Medical segment operates manufacturing facilities in multiple countries, including Canada, Germany, Ireland, Japan, Malaysia, Malta, Mexico, and Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cardinal Health primarily operates as a midstream distributor in the healthcare supply chain, connecting manufacturers with healthcare providers and end customers. In the Medical segment, it also acts as a manufacturer and assembler of medical products, while in the Pharmaceutical segment, it provides distribution, repackaging, and specialty services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing supply chain efficiency, expanding Cardinal Health branded product offerings, investing in technology and automation, and mitigating inflationary and supply chain pressures. The company is focused on optimizing its portfolio, driving cost savings, and pursuing targeted acquisitions to strengthen its core businesses, while also investing in digital and data-driven solutions for healthcare logistics and patient care.
categories.revenue_model: Cardinal Health generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of pharmaceuticals and medical products. Additional revenue streams include supply chain services, pharmacy management, consulting, and logistics solutions. The company also earns service fees from manufacturers and customers for distribution and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the Pharmaceutical segment, major competitors include McKesson Corporation and AmerisourceBergen Corporation, as well as regional distributors and specialty service providers. In the Medical segment, competitors include Medline Industries, Owens & Minor, and Becton, Dickinson and Company. Cardinal Health is one of the three largest pharmaceutical distributors in the U.S. and a leading provider of medical products and supply chain solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2023, Cardinal Health reported $205.0 billion in revenue, representing a 13% increase from the prior year, driven mainly by growth in the Pharmaceutical segment. Non-GAAP operating earnings were $2.1 billion, up 3% year-over-year, while non-GAAP diluted EPS grew 14% to $5.79. The company has a large scale, with approximately 48,000 employees worldwide, and continues to focus on operational efficiency and disciplined capital deployment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cardinal Health emphasizes cost-effective, integrated solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency and support better patient care. Its value proposition centers on broad product offerings, deep expertise in healthcare logistics, proprietary branded products, and technology-enabled services that help healthcare providers reduce costs, improve outcomes, and navigate complex regulatory environments. The company’s scale, reliability, and ability to deliver customized solutions differentiate it in a highly competitive market.
